decision.observation: The shutter is closed again after repeated handle clicks, while the next entrant is still approaching; the counter is clear.
decision.hypothesis: One click on the visible beige handle will reopen the shutter; pausing afterward should avoid reversing its animation.
decision.memory: Only Arstotzkan citizens with unexpired passports may enter. Avoid rapid repeated shutter clicks. Open the shutter before returning documents if needed, and confirm the passport disappears after return.
